## Issue reference

A closing keyword closes the WHOLE issue: GitHub drops any qualifier after it,
so "Closes #52 items 1 and 2" closes #52 outright. That has happened twice on
one issue here, and the second time went unnoticed.

  finishes the issue:  Closes #52
  partial progress:    #52 items 1 and 2. Items 3-5 stay open.
